notes.title: 内容更新 Ver. 1.9.211.981
notes.content:
Long time no see, today I finally bring you the update of version 1.9.



New available roles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/9e7b9a7a699670f81b5352b5536258654dd5af6e.png[/img]

Add a defensive character for Pelicans

Having reassuring protective abilities to protect teammates. You can suck blood on your own, relieve and treat stress.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/9de0d668508dad5a6e1e753f20d878df7f773895.png[/img]

Starting with the method, the main storyline reaches Chapter 8, heading to the upper left corner of the "Explorer Guild" in the "Potelaar North City District"

In the lounge, it can be seen that when Ji Yu is in the team, talking to her can make her join.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317360/_/?curator_clanid=40862707

New healing character (DLC) for 'Hanahime'

Super powerful therapeutic assistance, with frontline combat capabilities that are equally impressive in terms of attack.

In addition to the cute appearance of the character itself, there is also a kind of intense beauty.

Please refer to the DLC page for detailed instructions on how to get started.



story

Supplementing and enriching the early plot of the main storyline of Satoshi Kuzaki, with more descriptions of him.

Added a pre challenge task for future discussions called 'The Wise Trial'.



New interactive events and tasks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/056a55d72d59773b9ea4a1273aa4cc76e701682e.png[/img]

The actual installation of the old library of Wenhua College is located in the real world of Dongcheng District

Among them, there are over 10 interactive events and tasks, most of which are related to character favorability and can deepen understanding of different characters.



New gameplay and challenges

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/c77c0694045ff3f9f5d50977cd606169bc0600a5.png[/img]

The Trial of the Wise

You can receive tasks at the 'Wise Home'.

Trial corresponds to four new maps: Pyramid, Frozen Pit, Volcano, and Magic Crown Garden

Enter each of these four maps to challenge the four Dragon Kings and gain recognition from the wise.

There will be detailed guidelines in the task description, which will not be elaborated here.

Through trials, various new powerful equipment can be obtained.

Even obtaining the legendary 'Philosopher's Stone'.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/5b97d99804e8ab9d2ec2222ada47b0f19bd13101.png[/img]

The Mouse in the Wall

The new challenge instance is currently the highest difficulty.

Go deep into the underground maze of the Ikm Monastery to explore its secrets.

This is a complex challenge that tests everything the player has learned so far.

At the beginning, there are only ten minutes, and players need to continuously kill enemies to restore time.

You can also restore time by picking up an hourglass, while also considering various factors such as physical resources.

Every time you defeat a boss, you will be cursed to weaken your power.

But it can obtain various relics to enhance the team's combat effectiveness.

More challenges, more strategies, and more equipment rewards are all available in 'Mouse in the Wall'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/cdfeca9aebcbc3ffe5948a8d6bfda1d7ccb56c1c.png[/img]



skill

Corrected some skill description errors.

Fixed some functional errors in certain skills.

Enhanced some character skills to make them more practical.

Continue to optimize character building and strategy selection.



New AP skills

Broken Ice

When attacking a frozen target, the attack skill must be critical and the final damage will be increased by 50%. Remove the target's frozen state after hitting.

Arc Charging

Each time the attack skill hits the [electrified] target, the combo count is increased by an additional 1.

Blood Thorn

Attack skill increases damage to bleeding targets. Every 1 armor piercing point adds 2% damage.

[Blades and Flames]

The attack skill will definitely deliver a critical hit to the 'burn' target.



equipment

A level 4 badge store has been opened, which can be upgraded in Muguang Town.

Upgrade the quality of limited equipment in the level 40 arena from 300 to 320.



other

Added several interactive content in the real world.

Added more prompts for various tasks.



[Below is a digression]

There are some objective reasons for updating my situation so late this year.

Mainly due to poor health, friends who know me should know that I stopped creating comics ten years ago because of health reasons.

At that time, the workload and pressure were extremely high, and there were some heart problems that almost led to sudden death. But he has already recovered.

The pressure of making games this time is even greater than before. I have to complete the art, script, game arrangement, and even code all by myself.

I have experienced severe physical discomfort several times this year. In addition to the heart, there are also some problems with the cervical and lumbar vertebrae.

I have several friends around me who died suddenly due to work.

As the saying goes, a dog's life matters. So I slowed down the pace to regulate my body.

I originally wanted to tell everyone this news and ask everyone to be patient. I will definitely finish the game.

But mainly in recent years, there have been too many EA's running away in China, and I don't want to release such news to make people speculate whether I will use it as an excuse to run away.

So even if everyone doesn't understand me and blames me for delaying updates, I still want to create enough content before updating and speak with practical actions.



However, my daily routine is more stable than before. I went to the hospital for a physical examination and my condition is still relatively good. Everyone can rest assured about this.

I also thought about many things during my recuperation this year. For example, the experiences, difficulties, and problems encountered in developing this game.

I have also summarized many mistakes and lessons, hoping to create better quality content more efficiently in the future and present it to everyone.

Completing this work is of great significance to me, as it is a summary of the past decade.

It is also a turning point to bid farewell to the past and embrace the future.

After this work is completed, a related series of works will also be released.

Stories of different characters and gameplay styles.

Playing games is not only to express one's own ideas, but also to share fun.

It's better to have fun together than to have fun alone. As long as everyone can have fun, I will feel very happy

Everyone can leave me a message or communicate with me on social media if they have any suggestions or ideas.

I am very willing to listen to everyone's voices:)



Regarding the production progress of the female lead character 'Ji Yu'.

Actually, all ten chapters of the main storyline have been completed, so you can keep your heart in your stomach.

But it has not passed the complete testing yet, and there may be hidden bugs that need to be repeatedly tested and optimized.

It is expected to be updated within this month, and I plan to present the complete content of the story chapter of version 2.0 'Jiyu' to everyone during Christmas.

This version contains almost complete content, with different main storylines of male and female protagonists and all branching storylines.

The expected game duration is over 50 hours, and careful exploration of the entire content can exceed 100 hours.



Regarding the official version, what everyone is most concerned about is when the official version will be released.

I have already done some English translation before, but due to incomplete development of the ontology, it was suspended later.

After the completion of version 2.0, I will start the comprehensive English translation work. Once the translation is completed, it will be immediately converted into the official version.



The official version will add new content compared to 2.0, including a favorability system for 22 characters, a story chapter for future discussions, and a final challenge maze.

Please look forward to it.

notes.title: 2nd Anniversary Update Ver. 1.8.192.717

We have finally celebrated the second anniversary of the game's release!

Here we bring you a large number of updates on the latest content!

Game development has come to an end, and it can be officially released this year!

The next thing to do is to conduct the final major update of the EA phase next month.

notes.title: Recent content being produced and future updates
notes.content:
Today we will bring you some new developments in intelligence!

Firstly, some friends mentioned the issue of errors and missing files when playing the prologue at the beginning.

This is because the relationship between the old archive was used and the preface of version 1.5 was redone, which does not match the old data.

If players have already played the prologue, they can choose to skip the prologue at the beginning.

If the preface has not been printed yet, it is recommended to open a new archive. I have been driving new gears several times myself and everything is normal!



Next is the key point!

At present, we have been accelerating the development of the main plot of the female lead "Ji Yu". Some information has also been released before.

Now that we have reached Chapter 3, we plan to update it in one breath after completing Chapter 10.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/1822a27b1b3b1f12035d32ef32ed86b8a84fdeba.png[/img]

Announce a new character this time! This is the exclusive plot character for the female lead, the leader of the hacker network! Her name is "Cross", and she highly values the talent of the female lead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/43bdfaa5b3c5f61d0d4e2732db51cdb3487df496.png[/img]

Her name is' Pelican ',This character is also a very powerful hacker! She is an auxiliary character specifically responsible for navigating players in hacker missions, and she often interacts with players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/c50c796f607566cefb1d664dbe23c4aa49012cba.png[/img]

The protagonist Ji Yu's online identity is 404, so she will have a completely different look when conducting a separate hacking mission!


Finally, I will bring you the next update preview.

This week, we will bring a new level 40 dungeon called "Ghost Street" with a slightly lower difficulty than the arena.

After passing the level or reaching the full level, friends can obtain a new pile of orange equipment here!

——The following are the updated contents of this patch——

equipment

Add 4 legendary weapons to the arena for limited rewards.



skill

Fix the error of 'Moral Judgment' where attacking enemies cannot regenerate health.

Repairing the Holy Avengers will cause issues with Little Stuck.



other

Fixed an error where the death effect will be displayed again after the monster dies.

Added a guide to the arena boss.



——On the difficulty of the arena——

All bosses in the arena have been tested and verified with reliable data.

Players who participated in the test successfully passed the 200 difficulty S rating without being in their graduation attire.

The difficulty of the arena is not in terms of "training level" but in understanding the mechanism.

Fully master and apply the mechanisms seen in the game to restrain and ultimately defeat the boss in the arena to receive rewards.

In fact, on the day of updating the arena, some friends passed the 200 difficulty level and shared their gameplay and ideas.

Someone even dealt millions of damage and instantly killed BOSS!


——Current progress——

Developing the storyline for the female lead.

Some content will be announced in the future.

I am planning to update all 10 main storylines of the female lead in one go!

I shouldn't have to wait too long, I will continue to work hard to catch up!

In addition, the English version has also undergone some testing, and the font width issue has been resolved. The task description can be written down now!

However, with over 700000 words of accumulated Chinese text, it is not easy to translate it all into English in a short time......
The current focus is still on fully developing Chinese ontology content. However, the new content has been consciously and synchronously produced in English, and in the future, the speed of all English culture should be faster than I expected.
Please remember one thing, I am completely alone in creating content. I hope everyone can have some patience:)

notes.title: UPDATA Ver. 1.5.130.552
notes.content:

Star rating of new system roles

Add the 'Blessing of Stars' function, where each character can obtain their own characteristics.

Add a new scene called 'Star Temple' located on the right side of 'Moon Temple'.

Here, you can pour 'Moonlight Morning Dew' into the 'Holy Grail' to receive blessings and increase the star level of the corresponding profession.

PS: Moonlight Morning Dew can be exchanged with Goddess by collecting Moonlight Power.

PS2: All blessings can be fully filled, there is no need to worry about adding the wrong node.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862707/cfd78aad1691c286277e703c93d9601cb3a900b6.png[/img]
After the professional star rating is increased, all characters in the profession will receive a star rating increase and their characteristics will also be enhanced.

Equipping COST will also increase. After being fully upgraded, COST can reach 15 points and you can equip yourself with 3COST badges all over!



Add a total of 100 levels of challenges to the 'Trial of the Stars', with increasing difficulty.

You can obtain the Holy Grail for blessings and various high-quality rewards in it.

The difficulty level of the trial ranges from level 5 to level 43, throughout the entire process. You can choose to challenge at an appropriate time to receive rewards.

For every 20 levels broken, players can increase their HP, SP, attack, defense, spirit, and agility by+2%.

After 100 levels are fully broken, accumulate all attributes permanently+10%, helping players pass levels more easily.

There are also 4 unique advanced orange weapons waiting for players to obtain!

Some small talk
Although it is a little late now, I still wish you a happy new year! Everything goes well!

Last year, many things delayed the development progress, such as participating in the game production competition and making a new game. Later, if you are interested, I will also announce:) Research new game development engines to learn to improve their ability, and won COVID-19 at the end of the year. However, the update was finally made. According to the plan, the follow-up updates will be concentrated in the next few months. The basic content has been completed, and the subsequent update speed will be greatly accelerated:).

Another thing to mention about the English version is that the RPGMAKER VX version I use is older and has no multilingual support. The English version must be re-opened for translation and production. This will cause a lot of repetitive work when updating the Chinese version later. So I plan to translate the English version after developing enough versions. Another difficulty is that the display length of English and Chinese is very different, which is often much longer than that of Chinese. As a result, the skill and task description may exceed the window length. I need to modify the text content to correspond to the window length, which is equivalent to compiling the text again. The workload is also relatively large. I hope foreign friends can be patient. I very much hope to share my work with you!

Finally, thank my friends for their support and encouragement. I will create more interesting games in the new year! See you in February next time!

notes.title: The Early Access version of 《Lolita expedition》 is officially on sale today!
notes.content:
hello everyone! I'm Shu Yi, producer of 《Lolita expedition》.
I am very excited to announce that the PC version of 《Lolita expedition》 is now officially live!
Thank you for all your support before release!
The game is in the Early Access, and there are still many imperfections. I will strive to improve the game experience!
At present, you can play 1-5 Stories (10 stories in total) of the main line of the game. The game duration is about 10-15 hours.
New content is already being done (new folder). I will update the follow-up content as soon as possible!
If you have any questions or suggestions, please leave a message in the comment area. I will take every comment seriously!
